general.title: OMIX DEG Analysis
general.instructions:
Run differential expression from raw integer-like counts and sample metadata. Choose Table for one counts table plus one metadata table (CSV, TSV, or RDS), or MOO for one MOSuite multiOmicDataSet (.rds). Auto detects a table only when it finds one unambiguous counts/metadata pair; otherwise it accepts exactly one .rds and validates that it is a MOO.

The default column names match the included training example: GeneName, Sample, Group, and Batch. Replace them with exact column names from your data. In MOO mode, the feature and sample-ID columns are extracted from the object.

For paired or repeated-measures data, set Donor / Patient Column. Do not use technical batch as a donor. The analysis performs design-aware filtering, TMM normalization, and limma-voom modeling.

categories.name: 📁 Input Data
categories.help_text: Provide either raw counts plus sample metadata, or one MOSuite MOO (.rds).

categories.name: 🧪 Experimental Design
categories.help_text: Define biological comparisons and any sample-level adjustment variables.

categories.name: ⚙️ Processing and Output
categories.help_text: Configure filtering and the downstream expression block.

categories.name: 🔬 Advanced
categories.help_text: Use only when the standard defaults are unsuitable.

parameters.name: Input Type
parameters.help_text: Auto uses an unambiguous counts/metadata pair when present; otherwise it accepts exactly one .rds and validates it as a MOSuite MOO. Choose Table or MOO explicitly when an asset includes multiple possible inputs.

parameters.name: Raw Counts File
parameters.help_text: Upload a CSV, TSV, or RDS count table. If left blank, the adapter looks for exactly one attached file whose name contains 'count'.

parameters.name: Sample Metadata File
parameters.help_text: Upload a CSV, TSV, or RDS sample-metadata table. If left blank, the adapter looks for exactly one attached file whose name contains 'metadata' or 'sample'.

parameters.name: MOSuite MOO File (Optional)
parameters.help_text: One .rds containing a MOSuite multiOmicDataSet. Select Input Type = moo, or leave Auto only when the asset contains no counts/metadata table pair. The adapter extracts the raw count layer and embedded sample metadata.

parameters.name: Feature ID Column
parameters.help_text: Column in the count table containing feature or gene identifiers. Default matches the demo data.

parameters.name: Sample ID Column
parameters.help_text: Metadata column whose values exactly match count-table sample columns.

parameters.name: Samples to Include (Optional)
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated sample IDs. Leave blank to use all metadata samples that occur in the count table.

parameters.name: Biological Group Column(s)
parameters.help_text: One metadata column, or two comma-separated columns for a two-factor design. Default matches the demo data.

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated numerator-denominator comparisons, for example B-A or Treatment.Responder-Control.Responder.

parameters.name: Additional Fixed Covariates (Optional)
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated metadata columns to include as fixed effects. Do not repeat the donor column here.

parameters.name: Technical Batch Column(s) (Optional)
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated technical batch columns. They are included in the DE model and removed from the downstream expression block. Clear this field when no batch variable is present.

parameters.name: Donor / Patient Column (Optional)
parameters.help_text: Set for genuine repeated-measures designs. The model uses duplicateCorrelation and rejects unaggregated donor-by-group technical replicates.

parameters.name: Apply Design-Aware Low-Expression Filtering
parameters.help_text: Recommended. Uses edgeR::filterByExpr with the biological group design before TMM and voom.

parameters.name: Append Adjusted Expression Columns
parameters.help_text: Recommended. Appends batch-adjusted voom expression values at the right of DEG_Analysis.csv. This never changes DE statistics.

parameters.name: Remove Donor Effect from Downstream Expression
parameters.help_text: Applies only when Donor / Patient Column is set. Retains biological group effects for downstream visualization.

parameters.name: Normalization Method
parameters.help_text: Combined edgeR and voom normalization profile. TMM (default) applies TMM library-size normalization with no additional voom-scale adjustment. TMM + Quantile is useful for severe technical distributional noise; Quantile uses voom-scale quantile normalization without TMM.

parameters.name: Write Normalization Diagnostics
parameters.help_text: Recommended. Writes before-and-after boxplots and density plots of filtered log-CPM values. Use these QC plots to assess whether a stronger normalization profile is justified.

parameters.name: Duplicate Feature-ID Handling
parameters.help_text: How duplicate feature IDs are combined before modeling. Use sum for raw RNA-seq counts.
